[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-es[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Google Calendar sync stamp under the daily note's Events heading[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every daily-note `## Events` section that `bob gcal sync` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]reconciles carries one quiet, Bob-owned line showing which Google [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]account it was synced with and when; the line stays honest without [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]churning the note, cannot be silently taken over by another [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]account, and Bob Ledger Tools paints it as a live health light that[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]turns amber when sync has stopped.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]2[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]2[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob gcal sync writes and maintains the Events stamp[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]cli-stamp[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cli-stamp: add the stamp module (render, recognize, parse, refresh [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rule), run it as the planner's last step, add the account guard, report [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the stamp in human and JSON output, and update the gcal docs and tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bob Ledger Tools paints the stamp as a live health line[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]plugin-paint[dim] · [dim][/dim]after cli-stamp[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]plugin-paint: in bob-plugins, recognize the stamp in Live Preview and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Reading view, paint it as a muted caption, mark it stale on today's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]note, refresh it each minute, then test, document, and run `bob plugins [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sync`.[/#D7D7AF]
